[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Tasser''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] soldier and a member of [[Forty-third Advance Recon Squad|43rd Advance Recon Squad]]. [[General/Legends|General]] Garza rerouted Tasser and his squad from an operation on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to assist [[Havoc Squad]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When they arrived, they took [[Vanto Bazren]] into Republic custody.
